description: Create a blank campaign draft for selected contacts, a complete filtered contact group, or a complete email-activity drilldown. Saves a frozen, distinct group of up to 100,000 contacts (8 MiB); does not send email. Requires campaigns:write and subscribers:read, plus analytics:read for activity. Returns selectedCount and currently eligibleCount. Review/update the draft and schedule separately. Existing get_campaign, get_campaign_audience and update_campaign read, replace or clear targetLists.

activity.description: Choose at most one campaign/automation/node/transactional source. With no source, audience is required. An audience can also narrow a source. Includes every matching contact across pages. Marketers can use only marketing email sources.

bounceType.description: Only for bounce activity. Transient is every temporary bounce; Blocked is the part the receiver refused on content, policy, or reputation grounds, and Soft is the rest.

filters.description: Subscriber filters. Mutually exclusive with root and segmentId.

root.description: Nested subscriber filter tree, maximum depth 8. Mutually exclusive with filters and segmentId.

segmentId.description: Saved segment. Do not also provide filters or root.

subscriberIds.description: Explicit selected IDs, all owned by this company. Omit to select all matching contacts.

source.description: Provide only the matching contacts or activity object.

name: create_campaign_for_audience

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_campaign_for_audience` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

audience.description: The selection source, selectedCount, eligibleCount and selectedAt record returned by Sequenzy.

campaign.description: The draft campaign with frozen targetLists record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
